generic_domain.justification: Software Engineering is a broad field that encompasses practices, methodologies, and tools used in the development and maintenance of software systems. The inclusion of 'for Machine Learning' narrows it down to applying software engineering principles specifically to ML projects. This domain is comprehensive as it touches on all aspects needed to build robust ML systems, integrating with existing software components, ensuring scalability, maintainability, deployment strategies, model management, etc. It inherently covers any subdomains listed under it such as machine learning for code or programming.
